name: GMSOL (GMTrade, six programs)
not_assessed: the money behind one key (no money figure, or no key count)
the protocol's total value locked (no DefiLlama match)

requirements.label: Admin power is not a bare key
A confirmed delay before changes apply, no bypass
Bypass paths of the delay checked and ruled out
Price feed not under one hand
No key shared with another tracked protocol

exit_window: none: a change applies at once

narrative.summary: The program upgrade authority is a Squads v4 multisig: 4-of-7 voters out of 7 members, with a 10-minute time lock. This is an upper bound: only the program upgrade path is scored, the in-state admin, mint and config authorities are not traced.
narrative.detail: Pushed on-chain 2026-10-10 (first publication of this target). Scored 65 / 83 / 0. The program's upgrade authority is re-read on every run and must equal the offline vault PDA of the named Squads multisig. Core and Exchange resolve to vault 0 of the same multisig.

cheapest_fix.what: a stronger admin setup (admin power spread beyond one key, or checked by others)

main_gap.requirement: A confirmed delay before changes apply, no bypass
main_gap.reason: Changes can apply with no waiting time

independent_read.path: program -> ProgramData CSp2sB… -> upgrade authority (a program-derived address, off the curve: a Squads vault or a protocol PDA, no key can sign for it directly) -> Squads v4 vault 0 of multisig CxnEVpQQcYa628TywzHGXeJ2jdVmbU51rnERat9xunP1
independent_read.posture: admin: Squads 4-of-7 of 7 plain keys; delay: 0 h Squads time lock
